text:
Samira: Quick note from BrightLayer onboarding call just now — two asks that felt blocking for their renewal discussion.
Jordan: TL;DR?
Samira: 1) They need a bulk export of per-route cost breakdown so finance can map to internal chargebacks. 2) They want an export of onboarding usage & errors timeline (CSV) for their audit. Both are must-haves before next renewal check-in. :warning:
Jordan: Ugh — we've had a few customers ask about per-route billing export. Do we have a short-term workaround?
Samira: Temporary: I gave them a Horizon report + screenshot walk-through, but finance requires raw CSV with columns: `route`, `tokens_in`, `tokens_out`, `cost_usd`, `timestamp`. They asked for a 90-day slice.
Akash: We can dump from billing-raw to CSV, but need to ensure PII-free. Also need rate-limit on the export job to avoid spiking infra.
Lisa: For enablement, if we ship a CSV template I can pair with them on how to map fields to their GL. Could also add a vaulted example in the onboarding repo.
Jordan: Notes for product: this is more than just CSV — the ask implies per-route attribution (some customers want token-level granularity). Can we add to roadmap backlog as a "per-route export + chargeback template"?
Samira: BrightLayer called out renewal in 6 weeks. They said legal needs the audit CSV before contract signature with updated seats. If we don't deliver, it's a risk.
Akash: Short plan: I can run an export and S3 drop this week with redaction, then we document the export query and schedule a controlled run weekly. Long plan: product work to expose per-route exports via Console API.
Jordan: Agree. Action items: 1) Akash to produce a redacted CSV drop by Thu EOD. 2) Lisa to create mapping template and 30-min walkthrough with BrightLayer. 3) Jordan to triage product ticket and scope MVP. Samira to confirm with customer timeline.
Samira: Confirmed — I'll tell them Thu EOD and get approval for S3 location.
CS-Bot: Reminder — BrightLayer renewal touchpoint scheduled in 5 business days (calendar invite sent).
Jordan: I'll create a lightweight product ticket with acceptance criteria: sample CSV schema, S3 delivery flow, auth/access controls, and an API endpoint stub for downstream automation.
Samira: Adding BrightLayer quote: "We love Redwood's perf, but without a transparent export we can't internalize costs." — they emphasized transparency > new features.
Lisa: I'll prep the walkthrough doc and a short recording they can reuse.
Akash: I'll ping infra for a safe export window and attach the redaction script here when ready:
Akash: ```bash
# export snippet (redacts user ids)
psql billing -c "COPY (SELECT route, tokens_in, tokens_out, (tokens_in+tokens_out)*rate AS cost_usd, recorded_at AS timestamp FROM billing_raw WHERE recorded_at >= now() - interval '90 days') TO STDOUT WITH CSV HEADER" | sed -E 's/[^,]+@[^,]+/REDACTED_EMAIL/g' > brightlayer_export_90d.csv
```
Jordan: Perfect. Samira — can you share the expected S3 path or whether BrightLayer needs direct S3 access?
Samira: They prefer a secure S3 link (pre-signed) to hand to finance.
Jordan: OK. I'll add presigned-link delivery to the ticket.
Samira: Thanks all — will update thread after Thu drop.
Lisa: :thumbsup:
Jordan: assigning owners in product board now.
